name: create_npc
description: Creates a new Non-Player Character (NPC) for the game.

species.description: The species of the NPC (e.g., Human, Elf).

ac.description: The Armor Class of the NPC.

max_hp.description: The maximum hit points of the NPC.

current_hp.description: The current hit points of the NPC. Defaults to max_hp if not provided.

temporary_hp.description: The temporary hit points of the NPC. Defaults to 0.

speeds.description: The speeds of the NPC (e.g., '30ft, fly 60ft').

str.description: The Strength score of the NPC.

dex.description: The Dexterity score of the NPC.

con.description: The Constitution score of the NPC.

int_.description: The Intelligence score of the NPC.

wis.description: The Wisdom score of the NPC.

cha.description: The Charisma score of the NPC.

pb.description: The Proficiency Bonus of the NPC.

skills.description: The skills of the NPC (e.g., 'Perception +5, Stealth +7').

senses.description: The senses of the NPC (e.g., 'Darkvision 60ft, Passive Perception 15').

languages.description: The languages spoken by the NPC.

cr.description: The Challenge Rating of the NPC.
